basic_profile.bio: I'm a 28-year-old software engineer based in Austin, Texas. Recently got into gaming, especially RPGs like Exiled Kingdoms. I enjoy exploring the mechanics of different character classes and how they affect gameplay. Besides gaming, I'm interested in biotech investments, particularly in companies like Atossa Therapeutics. I usually browse Reddit in the evenings after work. I'm single and enjoy spending my weekends exploring new games or reading up on the latest in cryptocurrency trends.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in computer science with a Bachelor's degree from UT Austin. My interest in biotechnology investments is self-taught, driven by personal curiosity and supplemented by online courses and forums. I enjoy gaming as a hobby and have been learning about game mechanics through trial and error.
